## Summary

```text
Pause button layer (shared alpha / stage clock)
  ├ retained Settings / Hotkeys
  └ retained Info
supplied SWF → settings rasters / font fields
```

Replace generic settings controls with authored placements and option frames. Pause retains row identities, retraction history and one active dialog across Settings, Hotkeys and Info. Main-menu rendering/fades follow separately.

## Evidence

- **Before:** generic controls and a separate settings dialog discard row motion/history.
  **After:** native/mock checks preserve source-frame gates, row identity/depth, shared opacity, independent freeze rules, bitmap ownership, hotkey draft commit and focus.
- Formatting, TypeScript,450 tests /5750 assertions and production build pass. All22 affected native/mock browser cases and the complete56-case mock/synthetic selection pass.
- Native menu/hotkey/pause captures inspected against stored original settled-pause settings reference22. This supports foreground comparison; different world pixels and the current menu backdrop are not synchronized pixel evidence.
- Source audit confirms persistent Click selection, duplicate/Escape binding and commit on Back. The outside-deselect handler is never registered. Listener/phase/focus handoffs now use layout effects while preserving #30/#31 corrections.
- A247-placement metadata audit found no omitted skew/nonidentity placement color transforms. Runtime SWF supplies the artwork; no original media is committed.
- Supported offline pack0 hides Lock, matching the source gate. Unlocked-pack1 UI, MouseUp/click event differences, exact text/filter pixels and full-game parity remain limits. Existing zoom, Restore defaults and unselected Escape navigation remain browser additions.

- CI follow-up: the first hosted run passed51 cases (4 native skips) and exhausted the paused-settings case's90-second budget after successful15–19-second software-rendered pointer actions. The scenario now has150seconds; all actions/assertions remain. Both affected native/mock cases pass again locally. Product timing is unchanged; the new CI run must pass before merge.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** menus

Changes native settings rendering and pause ownership. The old menu poster remains available until its separate renderer integration. Bitmap, input and preferred-FPS corrections remain intact.
